key_terms: A Kafka node role that manages cluster metadata through Kafka's own quorum. Kafka 4.x runs only in KRaft mode.
The setting that assigns broker, controller or both roles to a node. The workshop runs both in one process, so it has no high availability.
The first endpoint a client contacts to fetch cluster metadata, after which it connects to the partition leaders that metadata names.
The address a broker returns to clients in metadata. Advertising localhost to a client in another container makes that client connect to itself.
The saved cluster identifier that must match the retained metadata and log volume. The startup script refuses a mismatched volume instead of formatting it.
evidence: Actual owned Docker workshop observations, with source, failure and lifecycle scope stated separately. Commands are not executed by the classroom pad.
